Lock Aspect

Code: PRBN

Only in Etherlords II

Enchanted creature cannot dissipate or be dissipated. If enchanted pale creature is forced to dissipate due to damage dealt to it or spell effect, it is destroyed instead of dissipation, enchanted creature's controller loses life equal to base power of the enchanted creature and enchantment will return to the caster's hand.
